name: Video generation (Sora)
summary: POST /v1/videos with `model: sora-2` / `sora-2-pro` — async video generation from a text prompt.
description: Sora video generation is the `POST /v1/videos` API surface for creating short videos from a prompt with a top-level `model` such as `sora-2`. It solves async text-to-video generation, with the generated job later polled or delivered by the video service.
